title: ReporTree
description: ReporTree is a surveillance-oriented tool for identifying and characterizing pathogen genetic clusters. It links genomic clustering results with epidemiological metadata to support reproducible surveillance reporting.
practicalUse: Public health genomics users can use ReporTree to detect clusters from pathogen genomic data, summarize them with epidemiological metadata and produce standardized outputs for surveillance and outbreak review.
formatDetails: GitHub repository for an open-source pathogen genomic surveillance pipeline.
legacyTags: Classified as interactive-tool because the controlled taxonomy does not include software repository or bioinformatics pipeline.
